name: Moon Calendar
description: The Moon in UK time (GMT or BST): today's phase and moonrise at UK places, full and new Moon dates with supermoons and blue Moons, a month calendar, eclipses seen from the UK, dark-sky nights, spring and neap tide dates, the Moon's sign and new crescent sightings. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint; no sign-in.
author: Pyxl
